summary: Daily-transaction verification/browse batch. Reads each daily transaction, looks up its card in the cross-reference, and (if found) reads the matching account, displaying the results. A read-only validation pre-pass that reports invalid cards and missing accounts but does not post anything. Opens six files (daily transactions, customer, cross-reference, card, account, transaction).

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open all six files. Loop until end of the daily-transaction file: read the next transaction and display it. Look up the card number in the cross-reference; if found, read the account and, if the account is missing, display 'account not found'; if the card is not found, display that the card could not be verified and skip the transaction. After the loop, close all files and return.
branches: IF WS-ACCT-READ-STATUS NOT = 0 -> account not found
paragraphs.notes: Read-only verification pass over the daily transactions.

paragraphs.name: 2000-LOOKUP-XREF
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the cross-reference by card number. If not found, display 'invalid card number' and set the xref read status to 4; if found, display the card/account/customer ids.
branches: READ ... INVALID KEY -> status 4 ELSE display

annotations.note: Card must exist in the cross-reference or the transaction is skipped.

paragraphs.name: 3000-READ-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account by account id. If not found, display 'invalid account number' and set the account read status to 4; if found, display success.
branches: READ ... INVALID KEY -> status 4 ELSE display

paragraphs.name: 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the next daily transaction; status '10' means end-of-file, other non-'00' abends.
branches: IF DALYTRAN-STATUS = '00' ... ELSE IF '10' ... ELSE error
IF APPL-AOK ... ELSE IF APPL-EOF ... ELSE abend
